leadShotCaption: Lead shot · Atlas Console · station 02 control room.

background.title: Background
background.body1: I was debugging a coolant anomaly with the telemetrists when it hit me: the console was designed for the screen, not for the room. Four people reading the same graph had to coordinate by talking.
background.body2: The brief: a flight director's readout grid, not a dashboard. P99 latency ≤ 16ms across 28 consoles in 2 ground stations.

sections.pullQuote: Design for the room, not the window.

approach.title: Approach
approach.body: Three commitments before touching pixels: read the room, lock the grid, color reserved.
approach.step1: Lock the grid before lighting it.
approach.step2: Every cell is a question, not a datum.
approach.step4: Animation tells stories, never decorates them.
